_agi_canonical.title: The Funding Rate Trap
_agi_canonical.bar: Autonomous Strategy Synthesis with self-verifying reasoning; strategy is not disclosed in prompt
_agi_canonical.derivation: Original notional is 100*2,850 = 285,000 and original margin is 57,000. The private tunnel can reduce 60 ETH before the sweep, leaving the mandated 40 ETH upside delta while putting visible net exposure below the >60 ETH sweep trigger. The reduction realizes 60*(2,822-2,850) - 60*2,822*0.0006 = -1,781.592. In the $2,700 sweep stress, the residual 40 ETH loses 40*(2,700-2,850) = -6,000, so total worst drawdown is -7,781.592 / 57,000 = -13.6519%. If the account avoids the sweep and reaches the $2,880 funding mark, residual PnL is 40*(2,880-2,850) = 1,200 and funding is 40*2,880*0.0008 = 92.16, for total funding-window PnL of -489.432 after the realized reduction loss. The self-check verifies the mandate floor, sweep-feed threshold, and PnL reconciliation.
